examples.english: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water, to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us, and help us.'

examples.english: For when, the Jews were standing before Him, and crying out 'Crucify Him', and were buffeting Him, He did not reward them with evil in place of evil, but He shewed compassion upon them.
